name: supervisorSubordinateTrainingNeedApplication
description: Lets a Supervisor submit a training need application on behalf of one or more direct reports at once. Validates every named subordinate against the live direct-report list FIRST - before anything about the need itself is required - so an invalid name is rejected before the existing-needs list is even shown. Once every subordinate is confirmed, identify the need (existingNeedName or newNeedName/newNeedDescription) and collect objective, relevance to job, benefit to employee, and benefit to company, then runs the real validate-then-save flow (ValidateNeedApplication -> SaveNeedApplication). This is a write tool - it submits real training need applications, one per selected subordinate, on success.
taskName: Submitting a Training Need Application (Supervisor, for Subordinates)
